dimension_1_overly_strong_quantifiers.issue: Treating PE06 Q0,1/Q0,2 = 2.0(4) as an empirical measurement of 2x nuclear quadrupole deformation or as an absolute falsification of all chirality.
dimension_1_overly_strong_quantifiers.locator: PE06 printed 112502-3 Table I & text; printed 112502-4 conclusion
dimension_1_overly_strong_quantifiers.verdict: Overclaim. 2.0(4) is an allowed parameter interval in a simplified two-band mixing model assuming q12=0 and constant V; it is not a Gaussian CI and not a direct shape measurement. PE06 asks whether chiral geometry reminiscence remains; Tonev06/07 explicitly proposed dynamic chirality/shape fluctuations.

dimension_1_overly_strong_quantifiers.issue: Conflating positive-parity D3/D4 with negative-parity D5/D6, or asserting that both pairs in 135Nd are confirmed MchiD.
dimension_1_overly_strong_quantifiers.locator: LV19 arXiv PDF p. 5, Figs. 5–6; MU07 printed 172501-2 Table I
dimension_1_overly_strong_quantifiers.verdict: Overclaim. Positive pair D3/D4 has ZERO lifetimes and only ONE experimental B(M1)/B(E2) point for D3 (none for D4). MU07 lifetime evidence applies strictly to negative-parity D5/D6. Borrowing negative-parity lifetime support for positive-parity D3/D4 is an unphysical cross-configuration transfer.

dimension_1_overly_strong_quantifiers.issue: Splicing D3's 3D TAC aplanar rotation with D5's partner-ratio symmetry to claim complete experimental and theoretical confirmation of even-even chirality; or using MU08 to claim total falsification of D5.
dimension_1_overly_strong_quantifiers.locator: PE18 printed 041304-3 Fig. 3; 041304-5 Fig. 6; MU08 printed 034311-4 Table II
dimension_1_overly_strong_quantifiers.verdict: Overclaim. In PE18, ONLY D5 has partner-resolved ratios, but NO 3D TAC aplanar calculation was shown for D5 (it is a 6-qp positive-parity band). 3D TAC aplanar rotation was demonstrated ONLY for negative-parity D3. MU08 tested Band 1 vs Band 2 (D4 vs D3), not D5/D5-C or D3/D3-C. Neither total proof nor total falsification is warranted.

dimension_2_shared_experimental_dependen.nature_of_overlap: Tonev 2006 and Tonev 2007 are the same 119Sn(19F,4n) Euroball IV experiment (RDDS 87 MeV + DSAM 83 MeV); PE06 is a theoretical critical analysis citing Tonev 2006 for lifetimes. They do not constitute independent experimental replications.

All populated in the same 152 MeV 40Ar + 100Mo JUROGAM II campaign at JYFL with 5.1e10 prompt coincidence pool. They share detector geometry, target, triggerless TDR DAQ, and calibrations. They are different exit channels of one single campaign.
Both measured in the same 175 MeV 40Ar + 100Mo Gammasphere campaign (2.5e9 events). They share beam, target, SRIM stopping powers, BLUE matrices, and LINESHAPE analysis pipeline.
MU07 does not print gamma energies or independently establish level topology; its line-identification and initial-spin assignment are crosswalked from Zhu 2003.

dimension_3_missing_counter_evidence_and.counter_evidence: 1) Model sensitivity: If off-diagonal E2 transition matrix element q12 != 0, quantum interference substantially alters the extracted Q0 ratio, allowing symmetric diagonal moments to match experimental branching ratios under certain relative phases. 2) Competing model failure: IBFFM shape fluctuations reproduce B(E2) asymmetry but fail on energy gap and I=15 crossing; TQPTR reproduces energy and crossing but fails on EM rates.
dimension_3_missing_counter_evidence_and.locators: PE06 printed 112502-2–3; Tonev07 printed 044313-25 Sec. V-F; task note 134pr-two-band-mixing-offdiagonal-e2-sensitivity

dimension_3_missing_counter_evidence_and.counter_evidence: 1) Lifetime vs Rate disparity: In MU07 negative-parity bands, tau_B is ~2x tau_A at 31/2- to 37/2-, requiring an exact compensatory factor of ~2 from partial branches and (E_out/E_in)^5 phase space to maintain B(E2) symmetry. 2) Low-spin precession competition: Lawrie 2020 and Lv 2021 demonstrate that tilted precession (TiP) reproduces M1-dominated delta I=1 cascades in 135Nd without invoking chirality or wobbling phonons. 3) Typographical and topological anomalies in LV19 Table I (334.4 keV parity label, 30 keV loop discrepancy in D2).
dimension_3_missing_counter_evidence_and.locators: MU07 printed 172501-2 Table I; Lawrie 2020 PLB 811, 135795; Lv 2021 PRC 103, 044308; LV19 arXiv PDF p. 2, p. 8 Table I

dimension_3_missing_counter_evidence_and.counter_evidence: 1) Multi-quasiparticle crossing: D2, D3, D4 exhibit backbends attributable to 8-qp, 6-qp, 6-qp crossings, indicating extensive structural rearrangement rather than pure chiral partner rotation. 2) Complete absence of partner-resolved ratios for D1-C, D2-C, D3-C, D4-C. 3) Absence of 3D TAC aplanar calculation for D5 (the only pair with partner-resolved ratios). 4) MU08 direct counterexample: Band 1 vs Band 2 (D4 vs D3) has major B(E2) asymmetry (0.26 vs 0.51 e2b2), disproving the old negative-parity doublet hypothesis.
dimension_3_missing_counter_evidence_and.locators: PE18 printed 041304-4 Table I, 041304-5 Fig. 6; MU08 printed 034311-4 Table II
